sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can say when someone goes in or comes out of a place using bemegy, bejön, kimegy, and kijön.
I can talk about getting up, sitting down, and lying down using felkel, lefekszik, leül, and felül.
I can say when I start and finish something using elkezd and befejez, and when I set off using elindul.
I can say I get something completely done, or eat/drink something up completely, using meg- verbs like megcsinál, megeszik, and megiszik.
I can keep a verb prefix glued to the verb in statements, and move it after the verb when negating with nem.
